correctness.rationale: Cayley rooted forest counts give exact joint avoidance probabilities (r-j)(n-j)^(n-r-1)/(r n^(n-r-1)); compulsory-root occupancy matches them. Total-variation binomial approximation follows by binomial-to-Poisson coupling of marked-hit counts; the Rayleigh count law and conditional binomial CLT yield the joint mixture. Exact enumeration of n^n maps for n<=6 plus 1,682 independent checks passed. The infinite conclusion is analytic.

value.rationale: The number of cyclic vertices with no attached tree branches is a natural local characteristic of the random functional graph. It exhibits a second, finer n^(1/4) Gaussian fluctuation conditional on the Rayleigh n^(1/2) cycle-root population, giving a non-Gaussian mixed variance. The exact mandatory-root law and finite total-variation approximation make the precise distinction useful for analytic sampling and structural inference.
